testsuite.name: changePriority

testcase.name: should reject when new priority is the same as current
should change priority and recalculate SLA targets
should change from EMERGENCY to LOW priority
should throw ResourceNotFoundException when ticket not found
should record priority change in status history with previous and new values
should publish PriorityChangedEvent on priority change
